audit.summary: A fixed three-point metric admits valid fractional solutions with arbitrarily small positive service radii. The printed potential then violates both its terminal bound and core one-step amortized inequality. Zero radii also make the potentials undefined. This is a demonstrated core proof failure, not a counterexample to actual recourse competitiveness.
